comment: Seven of the sixteen declared inputs have no jack on the panel and no name, so nothing describes them here. The Sum output is divided by four whatever the step count is (DressMeUp.cpp:286) and is scaled by the Output Range knob, where the manual calls it the raw sum of all four steps. The Step input range switch reads bottom to top as ±10V, ±5V and +10V, and its default is ±10V. The Smooth Step switch only has an effect while the STEP/CV jack is patched, because the fractional step position is zero otherwise (DressMeUp.cpp:249-262).
